title: 修订绑定知识
not_run_reason: needs a frozen dev/holdout suite, a verifier outside the workspace and a provider run; preregistration lands first so the run cannot be shaped after seeing results

task_cluster_definition.cluster: multi-revision set: constraint change mid-run, concurrent edit, stale test result
task_cluster_definition.independence: task is the sampling unit; tasks sharing a repository are resampled at cluster level

model_identity_observability.requested: gemini-3.8-flash (registry cobblemon/gemini-3.8-flash-high); backend revision not observable
model_identity_observability.claim_limit: same public label in the same window; no claim of identical weights

quality_margin.rule: a win needs fewer stale misuses with at most 10% more re-verification effort

noise_and_power_plan.plan: 9 paired runs; mutations timed by the harness so both arms see the same revisions

cache_order_design.order: randomized within blocks; cache state recorded per run

stopping_rule: stop after 9 runs; a stale misuse in the control arm is reported, not averaged away

holdout_policy.retirement_action: the holdout becomes validation and a new one must be frozen before another confirmatory claim
